scope.label: YC Summer 2026 top-voice evidence eighth pass
scope.topVoiceScope: Only real people listed in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts; emphasis on yc_partners and insiders.
strictPolicy: Accepted evidence must be a native post or native comment authored by the listed person.
Accepted evidence must have a verifiable post/comment URL and visible metrics.
Profiles, org accounts, search pages, inferred metrics, likes-only rows, and company reposts are rejected.
The top-voice-authored row must mention the target company, founder, handle, or domain in the native post/comment text or native quote/reply context.
Exact sourceUrl and platformPostId values already present in targeted-evidence-current.json are treated as duplicates and rejected here.
methods: Parsed local Summer 2026 company/founder names, handles, domains, and group partners.
Parsed current targeted evidence sourceUrl and platformPostId keys for dedupe.
Used TwStalker only as an X discovery index, then verified candidates with api.fxtwitter.com native post JSON.
Used public LinkedIn pages/search snippets only for direct post/comment lead discovery and native author checks.
Used HN Algolia, GitHub Search API, and web search for Product Hunt, Reddit, and YouTube coverage.

notes: No app/source JSON files were edited.
Third-party X mirror pages were used only for discovery. Accepted source evidence comes from native x.com URLs verified through public FxTwitter post JSON with visible counters.
Ankit Gupta's accepted @agupta row is identity-verified by native author name/profile as the listed YC partner, but @agupta is not seeded as his X handle in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts.
Several false positives came from generic company names or domain-root tokens such as context, Denta, LATO, Glen, and Cova/Coval. They are explicitly rejected here.
Social counters are point-in-time public counters observed on 2026-07-15 and may drift.
